reasoning: Direct US-Russia war crossing 1,000 mutual battle deaths was avoided even at Cold War peak because both sides are nuclear-armed and rationally fear escalation, and proxy deaths (Ukraine) explicitly don't count. But the 24-year horizon, collapse of New START (Feb 2026) leaving no arms-control guardrails, and sustained NATO-Russia friction give a non-trivial tail.

Only 9 states are nuclear-armed and adding a 10th deployable arsenal is historically rare (last was 2006). Iran is the most plausible 10th with near-zero breakout time post-Feb-2026 strikes, but it still has not weaponized and IAEA access ended; a 9-year window gives a real but minority chance via Iran or a knock-on proliferator.

Conditional on a >100-detonation conflict, the toll depends heavily on counterforce vs counter-value targeting; 100 warheads on dense cities could promptly kill 100M+, but many would hit military targets and prompt (within-1-month) deaths from 100 detonations more often land in the tens of millions, with the bigger toll arriving later via fallout and famine.

Unconditional: most probability mass is on zero offensive detonations through 2050 (no warhead has been used in anger since 1945). The right tail covers a single demonstrative/terror use or a limited regional exchange, with a thin tail toward a large strategic exchange of thousands.

Global stockpiles are ~12,300 and roughly flat-to-slowly-declining; reaching >20,000 by end-2029 would require ~8,000 net new warheads in under four years, far beyond even China's expansion plus any post-New-START buildup. Essentially structurally impossible on this timeline.

Conditional on at least one offensive detonation, the mode is a single use or very limited exchange (1-3 weapons), but conditioning on use raises the odds that escalation follows, producing a long right tail toward a regional (tens) or strategic (hundreds-to-thousands) exchange.

Median of peer-reviewed studies depends on the next conflict's scale: regional India-Pakistan modeling clusters around 5-16 Tg, while full US-Russia exchange studies (Robock/Coupe) reach 150+ Tg, with skeptics (Reisner) far lower. Median anchored near a regional/mid exchange with a wide tail toward superpower-war estimates.

Conditional on a >100-detonation conflict by 2030, a >=3C global drop requires large soot injection (roughly the high-end nuclear-winter studies); 100 detonations sits at the threshold where modeled cooling spans ~1-5C depending on firestorm assumptions and targeting, and the contested Reisner-style critiques pull the central estimate below 3C.
